from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to categorization."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause or category this document belongs to, as specified in the task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCaseInfo] = Field(description="A list of all extracted document titles and their assigned case causes")
